findings.title: get_harness_service is cached via @lru_cache so idempotency works across requests

evidence.lru_cache_search_across_backend: Only found in config.py for get_settings(), nowhere in acceptance.py

findings.details: The get_harness_service() function at acceptance.py:43-52 does NOT have an @lru_cache decorator. Every FastAPI request creates a fresh AcceptanceHarnessService instance, so _idempotency_store is always empty across separate HTTP calls. Without @lru_cache (or similar memoization), cross-request idempotency is impossible. The @lru_cache is only used in config.py for get_settings().
findings.recommendation: Add @lru_cache(maxsize=1) or @lru_cache to get_harness_service() so the same service instance is returned across requests within the same process, enabling in-memory idempotency to persist across HTTP calls.
findings.commit_needed: Add 'from functools import lru_cache' and '@lru_cache' decorator to get_harness_service() in acceptance.py
